changes: Removed public Lattice CLI Authority bundle generation paths, kept the CLI as a consumer of server/operator-provided trust env and API key sidecar files, fixed customer API key sidecar paths to resolve relative to the trust env file, and updated docs and smoke coverage.
usage: Place the server-generated lattice_authority_trust.env and lattice_staging-client.env together, then run the CLI with LATTICE_AUTHORITY_TRUST_ENV_FILE pointing at the trust env. The CLI reads the sidecar path from the trust file and no longer generates these bundles.
expectedOutcome: Open-source Lattice CLI users receive credentials from Lattice Authority Server/operator handoff and can run basic Authority client flows without local bundle generation or PROJECT_ID/GATE_ACTOR_* requirements.
actualTranscript: npm --prefix packages/main run build passed; authority-client, authority-status, and authority-completion smokes passed; lattice validate --story=B-491e --json passed with 9/9 verification intents; review_escalation_status passed full-3x2 after three local codex-cli/claude-code verdict rounds.
outcomeDiff: No difference after fixing the review-found sidecar bug: actual CLI behavior now matches the consumer-only handoff contract.
limitations: Review escalation evidence is local non-Authority host verdict evidence and does not claim authorityDone, fullAuthorityDone, or productionDone. This story does not implement server-side generation itself; that is covered by Lattice Authority Server story B-42a2.
pitfalls: The blocking issue was wrong-secret binding from resolving ./lattice_staging-client.env against the caller cwd instead of the trust env directory. Fixed by passing the trust env path into customer API key resolution.
